title: Soaring Symbols alliances
description: The alliance catalog in alliances.json, as kept in the repo: one entry per alliance airlines.json may name in `alliance`, sorted by name. The build adds `assets` to every entry of the copy it publishes and `history` to those with older marks (see $defs/published); leave them out of the repo.

published.description: The catalog the package ships in dist/alliances.json: every entry also has `assets`, and `history` when it has older marks.

name.description: The alliance's name, exactly as airlines.json writes it in `alliance`.

slug.description: The slugified name, which names the folder alliances/<slug>/.

ceased.description: Year a defunct alliance was dissolved.

branding.description: As an airline's branding, but primary_color may wait until the alliance's marks are in the collection; validateAlliances requires it once alliances/<slug>/ has SVGs.

assets.description: Added by the build from the SVGs in alliances/<slug>/; only in the published catalog. Empty until the alliance has SVGs.

history.description: Added by the build from alliances/<slug>/history/<year>/ when the alliance has older marks; only in the published catalog.
